"""Standalone repro for ticket #30191 (UnicodeDecodeError on .delete() with MySQL
utf8mb4): cascade deletion SELECT must only fetch referenced fields, so a
non-ASCII value in an unreferenced field never reaches the client under
Python 3 + mysqlclient.

Mirrors the upstream regression test: Origin <- Referrer (large_field) <-
SecondReferrer (referrer FK -> id, other_referrer FK -> unique_field).
"""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth", "repro_app"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

import os
os.makedirs("C:/Windows/Temp/repro_30191/repro_app", exist_ok=True)
with open("C:/Windows/Temp/repro_30191/repro_app/__init__.py", "w") as f:
    f.write("")
with open("C:/Windows/Temp/repro_30191/repro_app/models.py", "w") as f:
    f.write(
        "from django.db import models\n"
        "from django.db.models import signals\n"
        "\n"
        "class Origin(models.Model):\n"
        "    pass\n"
        "\n"
        "class Referrer(models.Model):\n"
        "    origin = models.ForeignKey(Origin, models.CASCADE)\n"
        "    unique_field = models.IntegerField(unique=True)\n"
        "    large_field = models.TextField()\n"
        "\n"
        "class SecondReferrer(models.Model):\n"
        "    referrer = models.ForeignKey(Referrer, models.CASCADE)\n"
        "    other_referrer = models.ForeignKey(\n"
        "        Referrer, models.CASCADE, to_field='unique_field', related_name='+'\n"
        "    )\n"
    )

from django.core.management import call_command
from django.db import connection
from django.test.utils import CaptureQueriesContext

call_command("migrate", run_syncdb=True, verbosity=0)
from repro_app.models import Origin, Referrer, SecondReferrer  # noqa: E402
from django.db.models import signals  # noqa: E402

# --- Part 1: no signal listeners -> only referenced fields are selected -----
origin = Origin.objects.create()
Referrer.objects.create(origin=origin, unique_field=1, large_field="x")
SecondReferrer.objects.create(referrer_id=1, other_referrer_id=1)

expected_sql = str(
    Referrer.objects.only("id", "unique_field").filter(origin__in=[origin]).query
)
with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx:
    origin.delete()
first = ctx.captured_queries[0]["sql"]
assert first == expected_sql, "SELECT not limited to referenced fields:\n%s\n!=\n%s" % (first, expected_sql)
assert "large_field" not in first, "unreferenced large_field was fetched:\n%s" % first
# everything actually deleted
assert Origin.objects.count() == 0
assert Referrer.objects.count() == 0
assert SecondReferrer.objects.count() == 0
print("PART 1 OK: cascade SELECT only referenced fields (id, unique_field)")

# --- Part 2: with pre/post_delete listeners -> all fields selected ----------
def receiver(instance, **kwargs):
    pass

for signal_name in ("pre_delete", "post_delete"):
    origin = Origin.objects.create()
    Referrer.objects.create(origin=origin, unique_field=2, large_field="y")
    SecondReferrer.objects.create(referrer_id=2, other_referrer_id=2)
    signal = getattr(signals, signal_name)
    signal.connect(receiver, sender=Referrer)
    try:
        with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx:
            origin.delete()
        first = ctx.captured_queries[0]["sql"]
        assert "large_field" in first, (
            "%s connected but large_field not selected:\n%s" % (signal_name, first)
        )
        assert Origin.objects.count() == 0 and Referrer.objects.count() == 0
        assert SecondReferrer.objects.count() == 0
        print("PART 2 OK (%s): all fields selected when listeners connected" % signal_name)
    finally:
        signal.disconnect(receiver, sender=Referrer)

# --- Part 3: non-ASCII data survives a cascade delete (the reported crash) --
origin = Origin.objects.create()
Referrer.objects.create(origin=origin, unique_field=3, large_field="ünïcödé ✓ 中文")
SecondReferrer.objects.create(referrer_id=3, other_referrer_id=3)
origin.delete()
assert Origin.objects.count() == 0 and Referrer.objects.count() == 0
print("PART 3 OK: non-ASCII unreferenced field no longer decoded during delete")

print("ALL REPRO PARTS PASSED")

"""Repro for ticket #30191: cascade deletion SELECT must only fetch referenced
fields, so a non-ASCII value in an unreferenced field never reaches the client
under Python 3 + mysqlclient (UnicodeDecodeError)."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["repro_app"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from django.core.management import call_command
from django.db import connection
from django.db.models import signals
from django.test.utils import CaptureQueriesContext

call_command("migrate", run_syncdb=True, verbosity=0)
from repro_app.models import Origin, Referrer, SecondReferrer  # noqa: E402

# Part 1: no signal listeners -> only referenced fields are selected
origin = Origin.objects.create()
Referrer.objects.create(origin=origin, unique_field=1, large_field="x")
SecondReferrer.objects.create(referrer_id=1, other_referrer_id=1)

expected_sql = str(
    Referrer.objects.only("id", "unique_field").filter(origin__in=[origin]).query
)
with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx:
    origin.delete()
first = ctx.captured_queries[0]["sql"]
assert first == expected_sql, "SELECT not limited to referenced fields:\n%s\n!=\n%s" % (first, expected_sql)
assert "large_field" not in first, "unreferenced large_field was fetched:\n%s" % first
assert Origin.objects.count() == 0
assert Referrer.objects.count() == 0
assert SecondReferrer.objects.count() == 0
print("PART 1 OK: cascade SELECT only referenced fields (id, unique_field)")

# Part 2: with pre/post_delete listeners -> all fields selected
def receiver(instance, **kwargs):
    pass

for signal_name in ("pre_delete", "post_delete"):
    origin = Origin.objects.create()
    Referrer.objects.create(origin=origin, unique_field=2, large_field="y")
    SecondReferrer.objects.create(referrer_id=2, other_referrer_id=2)
    signal = getattr(signals, signal_name)
    signal.connect(receiver, sender=Referrer)
    try:
        with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx:
            origin.delete()
        first = ctx.captured_queries[0]["sql"]
        assert "large_field" in first, (
            "%s connected but large_field not selected:\n%s" % (signal_name, first)
        )
        assert Origin.objects.count() == 0 and Referrer.objects.count() == 0
        assert SecondReferrer.objects.count() == 0
        print("PART 2 OK (%s): all fields selected when listeners connected" % signal_name)
    finally:
        signal.disconnect(receiver, sender=Referrer)

# Part 3: non-ASCII data survives a cascade delete (the reported crash)
origin = Origin.objects.create()
Referrer.objects.create(origin=origin, unique_field=3, large_field="unicode-ok")
SecondReferrer.objects.create(referrer_id=3, other_referrer_id=3)
origin.delete()
assert Origin.objects.count() == 0 and Referrer.objects.count() == 0
print("PART 3 OK: unreferenced field no longer decoded during delete")

print("ALL REPRO PARTS PASSED")
